description:
Application-level monitoring for Archestra platform deployments: HTTP traffic, Node.js runtime health, resource usage, task queue processing, and PostgreSQL database health

PostgreSQL metrics from the OpenTelemetry Collector PostgreSQL Receiver. Works with any PostgreSQL instance including AWS RDS, GCP Cloud SQL, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, and self-hosted.

options.content: Choose the deployment job. Process metrics are scoped by job and instance. PostgreSQL panels additionally require the selected exporter and its own job filter; Kubernetes PVC metrics are optional. No samples does not mean zero utilization.

panels.description: Estimated database storage utilization for Kubernetes-backed PostgreSQL. Uses summed non-system database size divided by the PostgreSQL PVC requested storage from kube-state-metrics.
panels.title: DB Size Utilization

panels.description: Database sizes excluding PostgreSQL system databases. The dashed line is the inferred PostgreSQL PVC requested storage from kube-state-metrics for Kubernetes-backed deployments.
panels.title: Database Size

targets.expr: sum by (datname) (rate(postgresql_blocks_read_total{job=~"$postgres_job",datname!~"template0|template1|postgres",source="heap_hit"}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum by (datname) (rate(postgresql_blocks_read_total{job=~"$postgres_job",datname!~"template0|template1|postgres",source="heap_hit"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by (datname) (rate(postgresql_blocks_read_total{job=~"$postgres_job",datname!~"template0|template1|postgres",source="heap_read"}[$__rate_interval])), 1e-9)

title: Archestra / Platform Health
